concepts.name: Number Systems
concepts.subject: computer_science
concepts.description: Binary, decimal, and hexadecimal representations of numbers.
learning_objectives: Convert numbers between binary, decimal, and hexadecimal representations.

concepts.name: Boolean Logic
concepts.subject: computer_science
concepts.description: Logical operators (AND, OR, NOT) and truth tables.
learning_objectives: Construct and evaluate truth tables for boolean expressions.

concepts.name: Variables and Data Types
concepts.subject: computer_science
concepts.description: How programs store and represent data using variables and types.
learning_objectives: Declare variables of appropriate types for a given programming task.

concepts.name: Control Flow
concepts.subject: computer_science
concepts.description: Conditionals and loops that determine a program's execution path.
learning_objectives: Use conditionals and loops to control a program's execution path.

concepts.name: Functions and Procedures
concepts.subject: computer_science
concepts.description: Organizing code into reusable, named blocks with inputs and outputs.
learning_objectives: Write functions with well-defined inputs and outputs to organize code.

concepts.name: Arrays
concepts.subject: computer_science
concepts.description: Storing and accessing ordered collections of data.
learning_objectives: Use arrays to store and iterate over ordered collections of data.

concepts.name: Recursion
concepts.subject: computer_science
concepts.description: Functions that solve a problem by calling themselves on smaller subproblems.
learning_objectives: Write and trace recursive functions with correct base cases.

concepts.name: Stacks and Queues
concepts.subject: computer_science
concepts.description: LIFO and FIFO data structures and their applications.
learning_objectives: Implement and apply stacks and queues to solve ordering problems.

concepts.name: Linked Lists
concepts.subject: computer_science
concepts.description: A linear data structure built from nodes connected by references.
learning_objectives: Implement basic operations (insert, delete, traverse) on a linked list.

concepts.name: Trees
concepts.subject: computer_science
concepts.description: Hierarchical data structures and common tree traversal methods.
learning_objectives: Implement tree traversal algorithms and apply them to hierarchical data.

concepts.name: Introduction to Graphs
concepts.subject: computer_science
concepts.description: Representing networks of relationships as nodes and edges.
learning_objectives: Represent a network as a graph and choose an appropriate traversal strategy.

concepts.name: Sorting Algorithms
concepts.subject: computer_science
concepts.description: Common algorithms for ordering a collection of data.
learning_objectives: Implement and compare at least two different sorting algorithms.

concepts.name: Searching Algorithms
concepts.subject: computer_science
concepts.description: Linear and binary search strategies for locating data.
learning_objectives: Implement linear and binary search and identify when each is appropriate.

concepts.name: Complexity Analysis
concepts.subject: computer_science
concepts.description: Big-O notation and analyzing the efficiency of algorithms.
learning_objectives: Determine the time complexity of an algorithm using Big-O notation.

concepts.name: Object-Oriented Programming
concepts.subject: computer_science
concepts.description: Organizing code around objects that bundle data and behavior.
learning_objectives: Design a small program using classes, objects, and encapsulation.

concepts.name: Discrete Math Foundations
concepts.subject: computer_science
concepts.description: Sets, logic, and relations that underpin computer science theory.
learning_objectives: Apply set theory and logical reasoning to simple discrete math problems.
